11th Level Clan Feature

Your speed and reflexes have reached their peak. You are now where attacks go to be embarrassed. You gain the following special abilities you can use once per turn.

Redirecting Flashpoint. When you have two or more creatures marked with a Speed Seal and you see one of them making an attack or casting a jutsu, you can spend your reaction targeting two marked creatures. Both creatures teleport, switching their current position on the map. This teleport happens before the jutsu’s effect takes place. If this teleport would take the jutsu or attack out of its range, the attacker/caster must choose a new valid target. If no creature is in the attacks/jutsu’s range, then the attack misses and the jutsu is Interrupted. Both Seals then are dispelled on both creatures.

Blink Burst. When a hostile creature marked with your Speed Seal would deal damage to you or inflict a Physical or Elemental condition as a result of an attack or jutsu they cast, you can spend your reaction, dispel the targets Speed Seal and spend 1 additional Speed Seal. When you do, make a Dexterity saving throw vs the triggering creatures attack result or their jutsu’s save DC. On a success, you avoid the attack or treat your success as if you succeeded their saving throw and they were forcing a Dexterity save. You also teleport into an adjacent space near them and can cast a Jutsu that requires an attack, has a casting time of 1 Action and only targets the triggering creature.
